oxygen_concentrator.title: Charge your oxygen battery to 100% tonight
oxygen_concentrator.reason: Your oxygen concentrator needs power. A full backup battery gives you more time if the power goes out.

oxygen_concentrator.title: Ask your supplier about backup oxygen tanks
oxygen_concentrator.reason: A portable oxygen tank does not need electricity and can cover the time your battery runs out.

oxygen_concentrator.title: If your battery covers fewer hours than the outage, plan where to go
oxygen_concentrator.reason: You need a place with power, like a family member's home or a cooling center, before your battery runs out.

cpap.title: Charge your CPAP battery tonight
cpap.reason: A full CPAP battery keeps your device running through a short outage.

home_dialysis.title: Call your dialysis center to confirm a backup plan
home_dialysis.reason: Home dialysis needs power and water. Your center can help you stay safe if either is interrupted.

insulin_fridge.title: Keep the fridge closed; food and medicine stay cold for about 4 hours
insulin_fridge.reason: Every time you open the fridge door, cold air escapes. Keeping it closed makes your insulin and food last longer.

insulin_fridge.title: Prepare a cooler with ice packs
insulin_fridge.reason: If the outage lasts more than 4 hours, a cooler with ice packs can keep your insulin safe.

power_wheelchair.title: Charge your wheelchair fully tonight
power_wheelchair.reason: A full charge means you can move around safely even if power is out.

general.title: Charge your phone and a power bank
general.reason: A charged phone lets you call for help, get alerts, and reach your family.

general.title: Tell your contact about the forecast
general.reason: Letting someone know ahead of time means they can check on you if power goes out.

general.title: Know your nearest cool or warm place
general.reason: Libraries, community centers, and cooling stations stay open during outages and are a safe place to go.

general.title: Keep a flashlight within reach
general.reason: A flashlight helps you move around safely at night without power.

general.title: Never use a generator or grill indoors
general.reason: Generators and grills produce carbon monoxide gas, which is deadly indoors. Always use them outside, far from windows.
